# Bastien Gaffet, bastiengaffet.fr

> Student in classes préparatoires in Tours, France, who builds apps, games and websites for fun.
> Public name: Bastien Gaffet. Not to be confused with namesakes in other fields.

## About

Bastien Gaffet is a student in CPGE PC* (second year of preparatory classes for
the grandes écoles) at Lycée Descartes, Tours, after a first year in PCSI. Outside
class he builds apps, games, websites and tools. He is the developer of Equiliz and
one of the designers of the Robot J4 robotic arm. Robot J4 was presented at EUCYS
2025 in Riga, where it received the CERN European Prize.

## Projects

- **Equiliz**: shared expenses app, closed beta, works without an account.
  https://bastiengaffet.fr/project/equiliz and https://equiliz.bastiengaffet.fr/
- **Cobblekit**: free Minecraft tools for players and server admins (3D skins, world
  journal, building board, plugin config merge, backup checks).
  https://bastiengaffet.fr/project/cobblekit and https://cobblekit.bastiengaffet.fr/
- **Robot J4**: robotic arm that plays Connect Four, with Minimax and OpenCV.
  https://bastiengaffet.fr/project/robotj4
- **Krino**: Windows desktop app (Tauri, Rust) to sort a photo library.
  https://bastiengaffet.fr/project/krino
- **Kairoo**: early mobile app prototype around mirror hours, never published.
  https://bastiengaffet.fr/project/kairoo
- **cdp-scraper**: command line tool to back up your own course documents from cahier-de-prepa.fr.
  https://bastiengaffet.fr/project/cdp-scraper
- **On hold**: Tourny (https://bastiengaffet.fr/project/tourny),
  PrepaTrack (https://bastiengaffet.fr/project/prepatrack)
- **Lab**: smaller projects and experiments, code on GitHub: https://bastiengaffet.fr/lab
- **Cosmos Wallpaper Generator**: generative cosmos wallpaper tool sold on Ko-fi.
  https://bastiengaffet.fr/product/cosmos-wallpaper
